title: Commercial Drones Now Outnumber Recreational Drones
hook: Commercial drones now total 453,635, overtaking recreational drones.
closing: The drone boom became business infrastructure, putting more working aircraft into shared airspace.
question: Have you ever flown a drone?

segments.say: Commercial drones reached 453,635 registrations, overtaking recreational use and turning a hobby boom into an industry.
Total registered drones reached 837,513, putting more aircraft than ever into shared airspace.
New registrations slowed to 10,500 monthly, showing the market is maturing after its rapid expansion.
